{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build Debug

# Controls when the workflow will run
on:
  # Triggers the workflow on push or pull request events but only for the "main" branch
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

# A workflow run is made up of one or more jobs that can run sequentially or in parallel
jobs:
  validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@v6
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Copy CI gradle.properties
        run: mkdir -p ~/.gradle ; cp .github/ci-gradle.properties ~/.gradle/gradle.properties

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Lint
        run: ./gradlew ktlintCheck

      - name: Test and Build
        run: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug

      - name: Upload Apk
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: apk
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug
",
  "rationale": "Two evidence-supported optimizations are applied: (1) Gradle dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) reduces repeated dependency downloads, with an experiment showing ~20% elapsed time savings in a similar Gradle project. (2) Cancel superseded runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) avoids duplicate work when new commits are pushed to the same branch/PR, with synthetic experiments confirming the pattern. Both changes are minimal, preserve all build and test steps, and have no contraindications for this workflow (no release/deployment, no matrix, cache inputs are stable).",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200",
    "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-9a54817daee8f7d5",
    "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-560f8aa17cf2dbe5"
  ]
}
